newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns Aa2 to Global Ltd's dual notes.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns Aa2 to Global Ltd's dual notes.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had assigned an Aa2 rating to Global Ltd's two billion yen 5.50 percent dual currency note issue maturing in the year 2000.

The notes are secured by U.S. treasury notes and a swap agreement with Morgan Stanley Capital Services Inc as swap counterparty. The obligations of Morgan Stanley under the swap agreement are guaranteed by Morgan Stanley Group Inc.

Moody's said in a statement that the rating is based upon the credit quality of the collateralised securities, the rating of the Morgan Stanley group as swap guarantor and the structure of the transaction.
Global Ltd is a limited purpose company incorporated in the Cayman Islands.
